statements.status_notes: The fix requires rubyzip 3.4.0, a major release; there is no 2.x backport (2.4.1 is the last 2.x). GitLab pins rubyzip ~> 2.4.0 on the 18 and 19 lines and still on master; upstream's own update to v3 (gitlab-org/gitlab!254860) failed its pipelines and was closed unmerged on 2026-09-30, so the bump cannot be carried here without diverging from GitLab.
